hero.tagline: I build backends and integrations that solve a specific business problem. From architecture to production deployment.

about.title: About
about.p1: Backend developer since 2022. Focused on .NET, cloud architecture, and AI integrations — areas where technical decisions directly shape how a product performs.
about.p2: I work independently, directly with clients — no agencies, no middlemen. I take projects from requirements analysis through architecture to production deployment and handoff.

offer.title: Services
offer.lead: I work as an independent developer. I collaborate with companies and startups in three models:

b2b.title: B2B Contract
b2b.description: Long-term B2B engagement. Backend, cloud, integrations — as an external developer on your team.

project.title: Project Delivery
project.description: I build products from scratch to deployment. Analysis, architecture, code, delivery — no need to build your own team.

ai.title: AI Integrations
ai.description: LLM implementation in existing systems. RAG, agentic workflows, OpenAI / Claude / Gemini — with real engineering behind it, not prompt engineering.

process.title: Process
process.lead: Four steps from first email to running code in production.

talk.title: Talk
talk.description: 30 minutes — you describe the problem, I ask the right questions. No commitment, no sales pressure.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.description: You get scope, timeline and cost. Fixed price or daily rate — whichever fits the project better.

build.title: Build
build.description: Weekly iterations. You see progress as it happens, we adjust direction when requirements shift.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.description: Code shipped to production, documentation, handoff to your team. Post-launch support per agreement.

stack.title: Stack
stack.lead: A proven toolset — chosen for the project, not for the CV.
stack.exPcaTitle: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (certification expired)

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Describe the project. I'll reply within 24 h.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is Michael Czuba. Contact: contact@czuba.dev.

scope.title: Scope of data
scope.body: This site uses no cookies, collects no analytics, and does not profile visitors. The only data I receive is what you voluntarily send via email or LinkedIn message — sender address and message content.

purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis
purpose.body: I process data solely to respond to your inquiry and, if you decide to engage, to perform our agreement. Legal basis: GDPR Article 6(1)(b) and (f) — performance of a contract / legitimate interest in business correspondence.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body: I keep correspondence until the matter is closed and for 6 months after the last contact. Project-related data — for the period required by tax law (up to 5 years) or less, depending on the contract.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, object to processing, and port your data. To exercise these rights, write to contact@czuba.dev.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: I do not sell or share data with third parties. Exception: email service providers as processors within the necessary technical scope.
